marks.gloss_en: it was taught: which is not so in the Torah [reading] -- there, two reading do not fulfil it
what is the reason? since it is cherished, they give their attention and hear
ראשון שקרא ארבעה משובח -- דתנן: ...להקריב ממנה ראשון, שמצוה בראשון
the mishnah (Shekalim): the chamber is drawn down with three baskets marked alef, beit, gimmel, to know which was taken first and offer from it first -- for the mitzva is with the first
מכאן -- from the baraita's turning the lamps toward the middle, western lamp, the middle is praiseworthy
אמצעי שקרא ארבעה משובח -- דתניא... ואמר רבי יוחנן: מכאן שאמצעי משובח
the baraita: 'toward the face of the menorah shall [the lamps] give light' (Num 8:2) teaches that he turns their faces toward the western lamp, and the western lamp toward the Shekhina
ואחרון שקרא ארבעה משובח -- משום מעלין בקודש ולא מורידין
רב פפא איקלע לבי כנישתא דאבי גובר וקרא ראשון ארבעה ושבחיה רב פפא -- a precedent for the first-reader clause
the last who read four is praiseworthy because one raises in holiness and does not lower
הני תשעה הוו! -- the 'and God said' passages are only nine, not ten
״בראשית״ נמי מאמר הוא, דכתיב בדבר ה׳ שמים נעשו -- 'In the beginning' is also an utterance (= p_bereishit_maamar)
which are they? the 'and God said' passages of the Creation account
one may not read fewer than ten verses in the synagogue
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: the ten verses correspond to the ten idlers of the synagogue
the first [reader] who read four [verses] is praiseworthy
דאמר רב יהודה אמר שמואל: כל המצות כולן מברך עליהן עובר לעשייתן -- every mitzva's blessing precedes its performance, so before the Megillah the blessing is a mitzva
Abaye: they taught [the custom clause] only of the blessing after it
הלכך נימרינהו לתרוייהו -- the first closing, הנפרע לישראל מכל צריהם, is one of the two combined
הלכך נימרינהו לתרוייהו -- Rava's האל המושיע is the other
what does one bless after it? Blessed are You... who pleads our cause, judges our claim, avenges our vengeance, punishes our foes for us, and pays recompense to all the enemies of our soul
the word 'over' [in Shmuel's dictum] is the language of preceding -- the reading the stam's question asks a source for
what does one bless before it? Rav Sheshet of Katrazya came before Rav Ashi and blessed מנ״ח
פשו להו תרי, ואין משיירין בפרשה פחות משלשה פסוקין (= p_ein_meshayrin)
let two read three verses each
how is the Rosh Chodesh portion read [by four]? 'Command the children of Israel... My offering, My bread' is eight verses -- what shall we do?
היינו טעמא דתקינו רבנן: גזירה משום הנכנסין ומשום היוצאין -- the ground of the present practice
and nowadays, when all [the readers] bless before and after it
the baraita: the one who opens blesses before [the reading]
Rav Asi: the three readers correspond to Torah, Prophets and Writings
